_comment: Canonical key list for the audio/video stream-descriptor wire contract. The C++ engine (buildStreamDescriptor at Binder::writeX) is the authoritative builder; the Python parser (ai.common.avi.descriptor) must accept every key here. model_dump(exclude_none=True) means optional keys are OMITTED (never null) when unset, so the per-stream key set varies. A conformance test on each side references this file, so adding/renaming a key without updating both sides fails CI.
